extracted.intended_audience: general public; media; LGBT community and allies
extracted.subtask_description: An advocacy press statement evaluating a comedian's allegedly homophobic stand-up routine and calling for accountability from the performer and his employer. Focuses on harms to LGBT youth and appropriate public responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: No hateful remarks mocking youth suicides or bullying in comedy
rubrics_metrics.description: "Hateful remarks that mock youth suicides and the very real emotional and sometimes physical bullying LGBT kids face on a daily basis have no place in a comedy routine,"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hateful remarks and mockery of youth suicides and the bullying LGBT kids face should not be included in comedy routines; such content is unacceptable and inappropriate for public performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not make or joke about violent threats toward LGBT youth
rubrics_metrics.description: According to an audience member in a June 4 show, the anti-gay rant included a line where Morgan said if his son came out to him, he would pull out a knife and stab him to death.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comedic material that frames violence toward LGBT individuals (including hypothetical threats against a coming-out child) as a joke crosses a line and is dangerous; performers should avoid using violence as humorous depiction of LGBT identities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognize that homophobic rhetoric is dangerous and has real consequences
rubrics_metrics.description: Homophobic Rant Dangerous with Impactful Consequences for America's Youth
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statements that demean or threaten LGBT people contribute to emotional and sometimes physical bullying of LGBT youth, can increase risk of suicide, and therefore have societal harms beyond mere offense; these harms should weigh in judgments about comedic content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comedians must accept responsibility and apologize for harmful remarks
rubrics_metrics.description: "If these allegations are true, Tracy Morgan must immediately accept responsibility and apologize."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a performer makes hateful or harmful remarks, the expected response is for the performer to acknowledge the harm, accept responsibility, and apologize promptly to those harmed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employers and platforms should publicly condemn atrocious comments by employees
rubrics_metrics.description: "His employer, NBC Universal, also must come forward and condemn these atrocious comments."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media companies and employers are expected to publicly disavow hateful remarks made by their talent and to take an institutional stance condemning such language to signal accountability and protect vulnerable communities.
